coordinate_sensitive_semantic_sha256.algorithm: SHA-256 of JSON-serialized canonical tree [tag, sorted(attrs), norm_text(text), children], header element excluded

topology_only_sha256.note: Tag-subset filtering (road, link, junction, connection, lane, laneSection) did not reduce the hash because the canonical walker includes all children of tag_subset elements. The topology-only hash equals the full semantic hash. To compute a true topology-only hash, coordinate attributes (x, y, s, etc.) would need to be stripped from the attribute list.

changed_xml_paths: junction/connection (0 junction-level connections added — all repairs were road-level links)
mutation_analysis.lane_mutation: 0 — lane count, sections, and types preserved
mutation_analysis.summary: Mutation is limited to road-level link/successor elements. No geometry, lane, signal, object, or elevation mutations.
